purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom vision law profiles that require a real fog reveal mutation. This records reveal intent and target semantics only; it does not prove the native fog write, player-side visibility refresh, map object coordinate extraction, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredRuntimeProof: target descriptor to map coordinate proof
radius or target set boundary proof
law owner to reveal side correlation proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: movement bonus instead of fog reveal
object creation instead of visibility mutation
castle.road-tile-view-radius.notes: Castle road vision requires real fog visibility mutation around road-terrain coordinates and must match the road terrain predicate, not generic terrain or movement behavior.
